verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents email-infrastructure primitives: an API, webhooks, WebSockets, an MCP server and a CLI. A developer could use these to build background agents, but the product does not document its own automation, scheduling or rule-execution feature that runs autonomously. The Sim integration describes automations built in a third-party workflow tool, which earns no credit as the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
